title: Japan Cultural and Scenic Tour, Kansai First
alt: The Umeda Sky Building floating garden deck, Osaka
transport: Shinkansen bullet train, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Kyoto and Nara
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel on the river in Osaka, with a top floor bath house

activities.name: Kyoto cultural highlights
activities.description: A guided day through the old capital: the golden pavilion, a Zen garden and the torii gate paths climbing the hill above Fushimi.

activities.name: Nara park, Todai-ji and the Umeda Sky Building
activities.description: Todai-ji with its great bronze Buddha and the tame deer of Nara park, then the floating garden deck of the Umeda Sky Building.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Four nights on the river in Osaka, with a guided Kyoto day, Nara and the Umeda Sky Building, and a free day.

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Mount Fuji and Hakone
stops.hotel: Mitsui Garden Hotel Shiodome Italia-gai Tokyo
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Shiodome, a short walk from the bay

activities.name: teamLab Planets
activities.description: The barefoot digital art museum in Toyosu, where you wade through water gardens and mirrored rooms of light.

activities.name: Mount Fuji and Hakone with the ropeway
activities.description: The fifth station on Mount Fuji, a cruise on Lake Ashi and the Hakone ropeway over the sulphur vents of Owakudani.

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing with the Skytree
activities.description: Asakusa and Senso-ji with the Nakamise shopping street, then up the Tokyo Skytree for the view across the whole city.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Three nights in Shiodome, arriving by bullet train for teamLab Planets, then Mount Fuji with Hakone and a city day up the Skytree.

Check in at your riverside hotel in Osaka
Free time to explore the neighbourhood
Optional: an evening along the Dotonbori canal
2: Breakfast, then a guided day in Kyoto
The golden pavilion on its pond
A Zen garden and the temple district
The torii gate paths above Fushimi
3: Todai-ji and its great bronze Buddha
The deer park and its tame sika deer
The Umeda Sky Building deck back in Osaka

Optional: Osaka castle and its park

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Starting in Kansai and finishing in Tokyo means the long flight home leaves from the busier airport, and you never double back.
expert.tip: Both Mitsui Garden hotels have a top floor bath house with a view. Go up after the Nara day, it is better than any spa treatment.

summary: Eight days from Kansai to Tokyo: four nights on the river in Osaka with a guided Kyoto day, Nara and the Umeda Sky Building and a free day, then the bullet train to Tokyo for teamLab Planets, Mount Fuji with Hakone and a city day up the Skytree.
included: Included: 7 nights in four star hotels with daily breakfast; Shinkansen bullet train from Osaka to Tokyo; private airport transfers; Kyoto sightseeing tour; Nara park and Todai-ji with the Umeda Sky Building; teamLab Planets tickets; Mount Fuji and Hakone tour with the Lake Ashi cruise and ropeway; Tokyo sightseeing tour with the Skytree.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
